description: Standalone Kubernetes resource management desktop application with tree navigation and resource views.

tech_stack.notes: Use electron-vite for Electron + Vite integration. Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/vite plugin. shadcn/ui components copied into src/renderer/components/ui/. Main process handles kubeconfig and k8s API calls via IPC; renderer is the React UI.

architecture.main_process: Reads ~/.kube/config, creates k8s API clients, exposes IPC handlers for resource queries
architecture.renderer_process: React app with Tailwind layout: left tree view + right resource panel. shadcn/ui components for Table, Sheet, Badge, Collapsible.
architecture.ipc_pattern: renderer calls ipcRenderer.invoke('k8s:<resource>:<action>', ...args), main process returns serialized data

stories.title: Project scaffold with Electron + React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn
stories.description: Initialize the project using the official electron-vite scaffold: run `npm create @quick-start/electron@latest . -- --template react-ts` in the project root (the dot targets the current directory). Then: (1) Install Tailwind CSS v4 via `npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite` and add the Vite plugin to electron.vite.config.ts renderer config. (2) Add `@import 'tailwindcss'` to src/renderer/assets/main.css. (3) Configure shadcn by creating components.json manually (do NOT run npx shadcn init as it misdetects the electron-vite structure). The components.json should set aliases pointing to src/renderer/. (4) Install shadcn peer deps: `npm install class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react @radix-ui/react-collapsible @radix-ui/react-slot`. (5) Install remaining packages from key_packages. The app should launch and show a blank window.
acceptance_criteria: npm install completes without errors
npm run dev starts the Electron app
A blank Electron window opens successfully
TypeScript compiles without errors
Tailwind utility classes apply correctly in the renderer

shadcn_components_json.description: Create this file at project root as components.json

stories.title: Kubeconfig reader and k8s API client in main process
stories.description: In the Electron main process, implement reading ~/.kube/config using @kubernetes/client-node KubeConfig. Create API client instances (CoreV1Api, AppsV1Api). Expose IPC handlers that the renderer can call. Also expose a handler to list available contexts and the current context.
acceptance_criteria: Main process reads ~/.kube/config on startup
IPC handler 'k8s:contexts:list' returns all contexts from kubeconfig
IPC handler 'k8s:context:current' returns the active context name
KubeConfig is loaded and API clients are initialized

stories.title: App layout shell: tree view panel + resource panel
stories.description: Implement the main application layout using Tailwind CSS. Use a full-height flex container: (1) a fixed-width left sidebar div (w-60, h-full, border-r) for the tree view, (2) a flex-1 main content area for the resource view. Add a top bar (h-12, border-b, flex items-center px-4) showing the app name 'Innfiswindow' on the left and current k8s context on the right as a small badge. Use Zustand store at src/renderer/store/app.store.ts with fields: selectedResourceType (string | null) and selectedItem (object | null).
acceptance_criteria: Left sidebar is visible at w-60 (240px)
Main content area fills remaining width
Top bar shows 'Innfiswindow' and current k8s context
Zustand store has: selectedResourceType (string|null), selectedItem (object|null)

stories.title: Tree view navigation for k8s resource types
stories.description: Implement the left sidebar tree view using @radix-ui/react-collapsible. Build two collapsible groups: 'Cluster' containing [Namespaces, Nodes] and 'Workloads' containing [Deployments, Pods]. Each group header has a chevron icon (lucide-react ChevronDown/ChevronRight) that toggles collapse. Each leaf item is a div with hover:bg-accent styling. Clicking a leaf sets selectedResourceType in the Zustand store. The active item gets bg-accent font-medium styling.
acceptance_criteria: Tree shows groups: Cluster > [Namespaces, Nodes], Workloads > [Deployments, Pods]
Groups are collapsible/expandable with chevron icon
Clicking a resource type sets selectedResourceType in Zustand store
Active selection has distinct background highlight

stories.title: Namespace resource: list view and detail view
stories.description: Implement namespace resource support. In main process: add IPC handler 'k8s:namespaces:list' using CoreV1Api.listNamespace(). In renderer: when selectedResourceType is 'Namespaces', show a table (use shadcn Table component — copy src/renderer/components/ui/table.tsx manually from shadcn source) with columns [Name, Status, Age]. Clicking a row sets selectedItem and shows a right detail panel (slide-in div or shadcn Sheet) with full namespace metadata: labels, annotations, creation timestamp, status phase.
acceptance_criteria: IPC handler 'k8s:namespaces:list' returns namespace list
Namespace table shows Name, Status, Age columns
Clicking a row shows detail panel
Detail panel shows labels, annotations, creation time, status

stories.title: Node resource: list view and detail view
stories.description: Implement node resource support. In main process: add IPC handler 'k8s:nodes:list' using CoreV1Api.listNode(). In renderer: when selectedResourceType is 'Nodes', show a shadcn Table with columns [Name, Status, Roles, Age, Version]. Roles are derived by filtering node labels for keys starting with 'node-role.kubernetes.io/' and joining the suffixes. Clicking a row shows detail panel with capacity, allocatable resources, conditions, and labels.
acceptance_criteria: IPC handler 'k8s:nodes:list' returns node list
Node table shows Name, Status, Roles, Age, Version columns
Roles are correctly parsed from node labels
Detail panel shows capacity, allocatable, conditions, labels

stories.title: Pod resource: list view and detail view
stories.description: Implement pod resource support. In main process: add IPC handler 'k8s:pods:list' using CoreV1Api.listPodForAllNamespaces(). In renderer: when selectedResourceType is 'Pods', show a shadcn Table with columns [Name, Namespace, Deployment (from ownerReferences: find kind=ReplicaSet, strip trailing -<hash> to get deployment name), App (metadata.labels.app), Status (phase), Restarts (sum of all container restartCounts), Age]. Clicking a row shows detail panel with containers, node name, and status conditions.

stories.title: EKS and AKS managed cluster authentication support
stories.description: Detect when the current kubeconfig context points to an EKS or AKS cluster (by examining cluster server URL or exec credential plugin command). For EKS: server URL contains 'eks.amazonaws.com' or exec command is 'aws'. For AKS: server URL contains 'azmk8s.io' or exec command is 'az'. The @kubernetes/client-node KubeConfig already supports exec credential plugins natively — ensure exec auth is not disabled. Show a badge in the top bar: 'EKS', 'AKS', or 'Local' deincomplete on detected cluster type.
acceptance_criteria: App detects EKS cluster (server URL contains 'eks.amazonaws.com' or exec uses 'aws')
App detects AKS cluster (server URL contains 'azmk8s.io' or exec uses 'az')
Top bar badge shows EKS, AKS, or Local
@kubernetes/client-node exec credential plugin auth works without manual token handling

stories.title: ConfigMap resource: list view and detail view
stories.description: Implement ConfigMap resource support. In main process: add IPC handler 'k8s:configmaps:list' using CoreV1Api.listConfigMapForAllNamespaces(). In renderer: add a new collapsible tree group 'Configuration' (after 'Workloads') containing leaf items [ConfigMaps, Secrets]. When selectedResourceType is 'ConfigMaps', show a shadcn Table with columns [Name, Namespace, Keys (comma-separated list of keys in data and binaryData), Age]. Clicking a row sets selectedItem and shows a detail panel with: all key-value pairs from data rendered as a scrollable key/value list (each key in monospace bold, value in a pre/code block), binary data keys listed with size in bytes (values not rendered), labels, and annotations.

Table shows Name, Namespace, Keys, Age columns

stories.title: Secret resource: list view and detail view
stories.description: Implement Secret resource support. In main process: add IPC handler 'k8s:secrets:list' using CoreV1Api.listSecretForAllNamespaces(). Secret data values are base64-encoded in the API response — do NOT decode them in the main process; send the raw base64 strings to the renderer. In renderer: when selectedResourceType is 'Secrets', show a shadcn Table with columns [Name, Namespace, Type (secret type e.g. Opaque, kubernetes.io/tls), Keys (comma-separated list of keys in data), Age]. Clicking a row shows a detail panel with: secret type, a key/value list where each key is shown in monospace bold and its value is masked as '••••••••' by default with a toggle eye icon button (lucide-react Eye/EyeOff) per key to reveal the base64-encoded value. Also show labels and annotations. IMPORTANT: values must be masked by default to avoid accidental exposure.
acceptance_criteria: IPC handler 'k8s:secrets:list' returns Secrets across all namespaces using CoreV1Api
Tree view 'Configuration' group includes 'Secrets' leaf item (added in S13)
Table shows Name, Namespace, Type, Keys, Age columns
Detail panel masks all secret values as '••••••••' by default
Each key has an eye icon toggle to reveal/hide its base64 value
Detail panel shows secret type, labels, and annotations
